test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

His ______ of smoking in restaurants created a lot of issues in New York.
solution:
The correct answer is **"habit."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is talking about something that created issues in New York.
 
• The blank needs a word that relates to smoking in restaurants.
 
• **"Habit"** is the most appropriate option as it refers to a regular practice or behavior. (आदत, अभ्‍यास, ऐसी बात जिसे हम प्रायः बिना पूर्व विचार के करें और जिसे रोकना कठिन हो)
 
 
• **Example**: *I’m trying to get into the **habit**__ of hanging up my clothes every night.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *His __**habit**__ of smoking in restaurants created a lot of issues in New York. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hatred: **a very strong feeling of not liking somebody/something; hate. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए अत्‍यधिक नापसंदगी का भाव; घृणा)
 
• **Reputation: **the opinion that people in general have about what somebody/something is like. (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु के विषय में लोगों की आम धारणा)
 
• **Orbit: **a curved path taken by a planet or another object as it moves around another planet, star, moon, etc. (ग्रह-उपग्रह का परिक्रमा-पथ (वह गोलाकार या अंडाकार पथ जिस पर कोई ग्रह या अन्‍य आकाशीय पिंड अन्‍य ग्रह आदि की परिक्रमा करे), कक्षा)

37:Td34,

The correct answer is **"Variations."**
